title: eupatorium rotundifolium var. ovatum
intro: Eupatorium rotundifolium var. ovatum, commonly known as an infrequent variety of the Eupatorium rotundifolium plant, is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is said to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Eupatorium rotundifolium var. ovatum include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and promote relaxation, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which are known to contribute to its medicinal properties.
